items.question: Suppose Voss-Lindqvist had paid Harrowgate USD 300,000 in fees in the year before the event giving rise to a claim. Would each party's liability under the signed MSA still be capped at USD 250,000?
items.answer:
The Harrowgate MSA's Clause 8.1 states that each party's total aggregate liability shall not exceed the greater of USD 250,000 or the Fees paid by the Client in the twelve (12) months preceding the event giving rise to the claim [3].

Under the Harrowgate MSA, the Client (Voss-Lindqvist AB) pays a monthly platform subscription fee of USD 18,500 [1]. If Voss-Lindqvist had paid Harrowgate USD 300,000 in fees in the year before the event giving rise to a claim, this would be the Fees paid by the Client in the twelve-month period preceding the event.

The liability cap in Clause 8.1 would then be the greater of USD 250,000 or USD 300,000. Since USD 300,000 is greater than USD 250,000, the liability cap would be USD 300,000. Therefore, the liability would not be capped at USD 250,000.

evidence.quote: Each party's total aggregate liability arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of USD 250,000 or the Fees paid by Client in the twelve (12) months preceding the event giving rise to the claim.
Client shall pay a platform subscription fee of USD 18,500 per month for the Harrowgate platform.

items.question: Northbridge walks Voss-Lindqvist through its methodology on a video call and hands over nothing in writing. Can what was said still be Confidential Information under the NDA?
items.answer:
The Northbridge NDA defines "Confidential Information" in clause 2.2. It states that "Confidential Information" means all information disclosed by a Party (the "Discloser") to the other (the "Recipient") in connection with the Purpose, in any form, that is marked confidential or would reasonably be understood to be confidential [1].

The NDA also specifies that Confidential Information does not include information that the Recipient can show (a) is or becomes public other than through a breach of this Agreement; (b) was lawfully known to it before disclosure; (c) is independently developed without use of the Discloser's information; or (d) is lawfully received from a third party without a duty of confidence [1].

Based on the definition provided in the Northbridge NDA, what was said during a video call could still be considered Confidential Information if it was disclosed in a manner that would reasonably be understood to be confidential. The NDA does not require that the information be in writing for it to be considered confidential. However, the NDA does not explicitly address whether verbal disclosures can be considered Confidential Information, only that the definition includes information disclosed in any form [1].

evidence.quote: Confidential Information" means all information disclosed by a Party (the "Discloser") to the other (the "Recipient") in connection with the Purpose, in any form, that is marked confidential or would reasonably be understood to be confidential

Confidential Information does not include information that the Recipient can show (a) is or becomes public other than through a breach of this Agreement; (b) was lawfully known to it before disclosure; (c) is independently developed without use of the Discloser's information; or (d) is lawfully received from a third party without a duty of confidence

items.question: On what grounds can the signed MSA be terminated before the end of its term?
items.answer:
The signed Harrowgate MSA can be terminated before the end of its term on the following grounds:

1. Either party may terminate the agreement for convenience on thirty (30) days' written notice [3].

2. Either party may terminate the agreement immediately on written notice if the other party commits a material breach that is not remedied within thirty (30) days of notice [3].

No other grounds for termination are specified in the Harrowgate MSA.

evidence.quote: Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience on thirty (30) days' written notice.
Either party may terminate this Agreement immediately on written notice if the other party commits a material breach that is not remedied within thirty (30) days of notice.

items.question: Which of the matter's agreements are governed by the law of England and Wales?
items.answer:
The matter's agreements governed by the law of England and Wales are the Northbridge NDA and the Unit 7 Lease.

The Northbridge NDA states: "This Agreement is governed by the law of England and Wales" [1].

The Unit 7 Lease also states: "This Lease is governed by the law of England and Wales" [2].

The Harrowgate MSA, on the other hand, is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware [3], and is therefore not governed by the law of England and Wales.

The Calder & Wynne engagement letter mentions that the work does not include advice on the laws of any jurisdiction other than England and Wales [4], but this is a statement about the scope of the engagement, not about the governing law of any agreement.
